departure_services_vendor_check.name: departure_services_vendor_check
departure_services_vendor_check.value: vendor_id IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('needed', 'cancelled')

departure_services_dates_check.name: departure_services_dates_check
departure_services_dates_check.value: starts_on IS NULL OR ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

departure_services_amounts_check.name: departure_services_amounts_check
departure_services_amounts_check.value: (unit_rate_cents IS NULL OR unit_rate_cents >= 0) AND quantity > 0 AND paid_cents >= 0

documents_url_check.name: documents_url_check
documents_url_check.value: url IS NULL OR url LIKE 'https://%'

documents_url_required_check.name: documents_url_required_check
documents_url_required_check.value: status NOT IN ('sent', 'on_file') OR url IS NOT NULL

interactions_open_follow_ups_idx.name: interactions_open_follow_ups_idx
interactions_open_follow_ups_idx.where: follow_up_on IS NOT NULL AND follow_up_done_at IS NULL

payments_amounts_check.name: payments_amounts_check
payments_amounts_check.value: amount_cents > 0 AND amount_refunded_cents BETWEEN 0 AND amount_cents

payments_paid_at_check.name: payments_paid_at_check
payments_paid_at_check.value: status NOT IN ('paid', 'refunded') OR paid_at IS NOT NULL

travellers_child_contact_check.name: travellers_child_contact_check
travellers_child_contact_check.value: age_band = 'adult' OR (email IS NULL AND phone IS NULL)

travellers_sensitive_gate_check.name: travellers_sensitive_gate_check
travellers_sensitive_gate_check.value: (sensitive_consent_version IS NOT NULL AND sensitive_consent_at IS NOT NULL AND sensitive_purge_after IS NOT NULL) OR (date_of_birth IS NULL AND dietary IS NULL AND allergies IS NULL AND medical_notes IS NULL AND (age_band = 'adult' OR (first_name IS NULL AND last_name IS NULL)))

vendors_rating_check.name: vendors_rating_check
vendors_rating_check.value: rating IS NULL OR rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5
